capabilities: Annotate PDFs with pen, highlighter, eraser, shapes, and lasso selection stored as real PDF annotations
Extract highlights and comments into a Markdown note with links back to PDF pages
Draw in ```inkling code blocks inside notes, with strokes kept in separate .ink attachment files
Create blank, lined, or dot-grid PDF notebooks and handwrite pages into them
Navigate documents via outline, find-in-document, page jump, and per-page zoom
extras: Not yet in the community plugin catalogue; must be installed via BRAT or manually from a release. Makes no network requests and needs no accounts. Some PDFs (forms, signed documents) open read-only by design, and JPEG 2000 images in PDFs do not display.
motivation: The author started it as a side project because he wanted to work only inside his vault.
problem: Obsidian can display PDFs but offers no way to annotate them, and handwritten ink or diagrams inside notes are awkward on stylus devices.

relations.evidence: They are in the bundled PDF library, pdf.js.
Inkling rewrites a PDF through pdf-lib

summary: Stylus-first annotation plugin that lets you draw, highlight, and comment on PDFs and add ink drawing blocks to Markdown notes.
